Uploads a document to the Xceptor platform for processing. The document is accepted in its original format and queued for classification and extraction. API for uploading and processing documents through Xceptor's data extraction engine. Supports intelligent document processing using NLP, OCR, and generative AI to transform unstructured documents including PDFs, emails, spreadsheets, and handwritten forms into structured, trusted data. The API handles document ingestion, classification, field and table extraction, and confidence-scored output for financial services use cases such as trade confirmations, tax documents, loan notices, and client onboarding materials.
